changes.reason: Drop the diffuse V 4p shell (wf 16 to 18, about 30.5 Å², off-site), which shapes a landscape that will not localise. num_wann goes from 30 to 27, matching the published SrVO3 frontier runs.

diagnosis: The subspace is fine. Disentanglement converged, and every check except the sparse one passes. Under PDWF the 30 functions are Sr 5s/5p/4d (9), V 4s/3d/4p (9) and O 2s/2p (12). The spread panel shows one clear step between them. The 18 functions on Sr d/p, V 3d and O 2p are tight (0.6 to 4 Å²). Six are diffuse: wf 16 to 18, centred on V but 0.35 to 0.55 Å off it, at about 30.5 Å² each; and wf 19, 23 and 27, the O 2s set, at about 21 Å². The three ~30 Å² functions on V are the V 4p pseudo-atomic orbitals. That shell is empty in the atom and very diffuse, and it pins high, nearly free-electron states into the target. That explains three things: the spread minimisation wanders with non-shrinking steps at 4000 iterations; the hopping decays only slowly (tau about 3.5 Å, 12 % of |H|² beyond r_c = 8.78 Å); and the model fails the path comparison even untruncated (eta2 = 1.73 eV). Most of the hopping weight beyond r_c sits on the O 2s functions and on the Sr p-like functions that hybridise with them. Truncating it throws the O 2s bands at R (DFT bands 9 to 11, -16.8 eV) off by about 10 eV. This is a projector problem, so raising the iteration budget will not help. Changing the windows will not either: disentanglement converged and the frozen window is satisfied. The published PDWF frontier runs on SrVO3 with the same 1-8 exclusion use 27 functions, not 30, and reach eta2 of about 0.2 meV. So the smallest repair is to drop the V 4p shell (3 functions → num_wann 27). validate_deck accepts this deck: 27 PAOs, the bottom 8-band cut is still honoured with a 1.46 eV gap, and at most 17 states are frozen against 27 functions.
